sql: CREATE TABLE audit_meta_private.parent(a INT,b INT,CONSTRAINT audit_meta_pk PRIMARY KEY(a,b))
CREATE TABLE audit_meta_private.child(x INT,y INT,CONSTRAINT audit_meta_fk FOREIGN KEY(x,y) REFERENCES audit_meta_private.parent(a,b),CONSTRAINT audit_meta_check CHECK(x>0))
CREATE VIEW audit_meta_private.visible AS SELECT x FROM audit_meta_private.child
